verdict.rationale: Apify supports scheduling Actors/tasks to run automatically at specific times, webhooks to chain Actor runs on completion/failure, monitoring/alerts on runs, and API/CLI/SDK control for building autonomous background automations — core building blocks for background, autonomous operation. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating unattended long-running autonomous schedules in production, and no explicit failure-recovery/retry documentation beyond alerts.
